Commentary.Commentary: The Afghanistan bowlers were excellent this morning. All their bowlers had a poor day on Day 1 but they have come back strongly and snatched the momentum. Now it is onto their batters. They'll have to play well. The new ball is not going to be easy to face, can they overcome that challenge? We will find out.

The hosts however, will be disappointed with their effort this morning. They would have been eyeing over 400 with two set batters in but wickets fell heaps. That has been the case for them, just the two partnerships, one between Shanto and Joy and the other between Rahim and Mehidy has got them here. The rest did not contribute a lot. They though will still feel, they have a good score on the board.

That is a top effort this morning from Afghanistan and they have roared back into the game. They got the remaining five wickets in no time and have bundled Bangladesh out for below 400. Saying that, Bangladesh still have a really good score on a wicket which has started to play tricks.

Commentary.Commentary: Day 1 belonged to the hosts thanks to a brilliant ton by Najmul Hossain Shanto. Now with, 5 wickets in hand and two set batters in the middle, the home side will look to get to the 500-run mark. The visitors on the other hand, are expected to bowl a lot better than yesterday. Can they fight back and get the remaining wickets quickly?
... DAY 2, SESSION 1 ...

Afghanistan were not at their best with the ball, except for the last session, they were all over the place and bowled far too many boundary balls. The though did well in the last session and that is a positive for them. They however, will need quick wickets on day 2. Can they get it we will find out. The action begins at 0930 IST (0400 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

An excellent day for Bangladesh and they are well and truly ahead in this game! Afghanistan did manage to fight back in the final session but this partnership between Mehidy Hasan and Mushfiqur Rahim has yet again turned the tide towards the hosts. They lost a wicket early but then Najmul Hossain Shanto and Mahmudul Hasan Joy batted brilliantly. They added over 200 and laid the platform for a huge score. The did lose a few wickets in the final session but Mushfiqur Rahim and Mehidy Hasan have got things back on track. Bangladesh will hope the two can continue and take them to a big score.

Yet another session whcih belongs to the hosts! They are on course for a big first innings total. Najmul Hossain Shanto was the star with a brilliant ton. He got good support from Mahmudul Hasan Joy, he also looked all set for a hundred but fell short. The two have laid the platform for a big total for their side. Afghanistan on the other hand, were not that great with the ball, there is not a lot of assistance for their bowlers but the ball is doing a bit here and there. Still though, there have been far too many boundary balls from them and they will want to improve on that after the break. Can they do so? We will find out.

What a start for Bangladesh! They have scored more than 100 with ease in the first session. Afghanistan won the toss and chose to bowl first. It was a good decision and they got the reward very early on but didn't sustain with the ball for long enough. They were sloppy afterward. Too many no balls, too many freebies and runs were easy to come by for the Bangladeshi batters. Najmul Hossain Shanto was the aggressor while Joy knocked it around from the other end. However, both dispatched the bad deliveries away with ease. If it continues this way, Afghanistan will be pushed on the back foot. They will hope to be consistent in this next session and break this stand. Stay tuned.

Hello and welcome to Day 1 of this one-off test match between Afghanistan and Bangladesh. Two Asian teams go against each other in the longest format after a long time. The visitors will be playing Teat cricket after almost two years. However, a lot has changed in the Afghan side and in a better way. In this match, they will be without their premium bowler, Rashid Khan but so will be Bangladesh who will be without Shakib Al Hasan. Both teams still have a balanced squad and expect a lot of excitement in this match. Stay tuned for toss and other updates.
